_comment: Bog frog, Sorrowfen's ambusher (content-zone-7-swamp.md §2.2, C7): it sits in the bog beside the planks and leaps at whoever comes close, so a short aggro and no wander. Camouflaged: drawn faint while it sits at its spawn point out of combat (factors.camouflage). Immune to miasma. Borrows RatBite until it gets its own skill; entityType NpcPlaceholder until its art lands. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
